Last night in Shinjuku, flight from Narita in the morning. A: stay put and leave at 07:13. B: move to Nippori and leave at 07:45. Which would you pick? 👇

💴 The price gap surprised us. Take a guess, then look 👉 https://japanbystation.com/last-night-shinjuku-or-nippori

🅰️ STAY IN SHINJUKU

🚃 Leave at 07:13 on the Yamanote Line, change at Nippori to Skyliner 15, reach Terminal 1 at 08:27. ¥2,840.

🍜 Your last evening stays in Shinjuku, with no packing and moving in between. Your room is already booked, so there is nothing to change.

🧳 Prefer no change? The 06:34 Narita Express gets you there at 07:58, ¥3,330.

🅱️ MOVE TO NIPPORI

😴 Same Skyliner, boarded at 07:45: 32 minutes more sleep and no change with your bags.

🔁 The cost: a check-out, a 21-minute ride and a second check-in the evening before.

💴 A room 200 m from Nippori Station was ¥14,742 for 2 adults on Wed 16 Dec 2026.

💡 HOW WE DECIDE

1️⃣ Need to be at the airport by about 08:30? Take A.

2️⃣ Two big suitcases, or a cheaper room in Nippori? Take B.

3️⃣ Need to be there before 06:00? Neither. The first Skyliner arrives at 06:03, so sleep at 9h nine hours inside Terminal 2.

✈️ The last morning should feel calm, not rushed. Pick the option that gives you that, not the one with the shortest train ride.
